reason: It does not fit its region in every build made from this source. sky.6502 is INCLUDEd from render.6502 into DATA1 (bank 4), whose end is ASSERTed at or below REN_BASE (&B400, src/main.6502: 'bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace'). The shipping/bench listings end bank 4 at &B37D (131 free), but the gameplay build (build/strykers-gameplay.lst, built 2026-10-23 01:23 with the current tree; GAMEPLAY_SHIELD adds shield_hi and puts sky_edges at bank 4's end) ends it at &B3F6: 10 bytes free. The candidate grows the code by 37 bytes (recounted: old 17 bytes, new 54), so the gameplay build would overrun REN_BASE by 27 and fail to assemble. The grind's BUILDS (bench/full/ship/release) never build the gameplay flags, so the gate would not see it; CLAUDE.md treats -Gameplay/make gameplay as a build of this same source. Otherwise from the project lens it looked sound: bank 4 sideways RAM is writable so the self-modified BRA operand is fine under ROMSEL &04/&84, ACCCON X does not affect &9000-&BFFF, and the reads of (s_ptr),Y are unchanged.
